office.source: tests/fixtures/roomplan/office.json, built as `arrival demo --from-roomplan` builds it (seed 0)

planner_system_prompt: Return only JSON: {"family": one of counter_to_sink|counter_to_counter|open_drawer|open_door|close_drawer|close_door|put_in_drawer|wipe_counter|open_fridge|move_on_table|open_oven|open_dishwasher|turn_on_faucet|load_dishwasher|unload_dishwasher, "object": id|null, "target": id|null}

sets.generated: wordings Nemotron Lightning wrote for the 9 families the planner prompt listed first; hero kitchen
sets.indirect: written by us, naming the goal rather than the action; hero kitchen
sets.blind: from planner-blind-requests.json, written by people who had not seen the planner prompt but were given all 15 sim families in plain words; scored over all rows, and under listed_families over the rows asking for one of the 9 families the prompt listed before it offered all 15 (planner_system_prompt is the prompt this run used). A language test: rows the sim could not run are kept and counted in sim_not_executable (rows[].sim_executable)
sets.out_of_scope: written by us; no family fits, so there is no right answer: the confusion counts under out_of_scope are what each planner picked
sets.unlisted_families: written by us for open_oven, open_dishwasher, load_dishwasher, unload_dishwasher, turn_on_faucet and move_on_table, which the 9-family planner prompt did not list (they failed by construction under it; planner_system_prompt is the prompt this run used), and the keyword parser cannot return these families at all. Each runs in the room whose twin has the fixture its sim task needs (rows[].inventory): oven and dishwasher in kitchen_real_01, faucet in hero_kitchen, table in office

note: The indirect, out_of_scope and unlisted_families sets are written by us, not sampled from users. A reply _parse_plan rejected falls back to the rule parser: the v1 fields (nemotron_ok, nemotron_right) count it under nemotron with source rule_based, every v2 rate (family, object, right) counts it as wrong. Rates carry Wilson 95% intervals (arrival.eval.harness).
